# db-06 — DataBall `.ball` v3 must be a DuckDB file

`Open` attaches a `.ball` with no import; the session store and the parked file are the same DuckDB file; `SaveAsync` checkpoints and copies; ZIP `.ball` v1/v2 still import. Read-only default and snapshot policy come from the db-05 decision record.

**Findings:** owner interview (2026-10-08) · **Size:** L · **Tree:** databall

**2026-10-09** — From db-02 review (2026-10-08): a dimension-growth re-split rewrites every layout table; in a file-backed .ball the file may not shrink without CHECKPOINT/VACUUM (general DuckDB knowledge, unverified). Include that in the save path.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-10** — From db-05 review (2026-10-09): read-only opens must also pass the in-process gate, since DuckDbStore (src/DataBall/DuckDbStore.cs:36-41) rejects a second DataBall on the same path regardless of mode, and every open writes meta (:51-56). db-05 DuckDB sizes are whole 256 KiB blocks plus a 12 KiB header, so measure size at a realistic row count before choosing the ZIP-fallback default. DuckDB's concurrency page mentions the Quack remote protocol (beta as of v1.5.2) for multi-process access; the snapshot recommendation assumes it is not used.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R
